python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os

source = Path('notes.txt')
target = Path('notes.md')
if os.path.lexists(source) or os.path.lexists(target):
    raise SystemExit('Stopped: notes.txt or notes.md already exists; no files changed.')
with source.open('x') as f:
    f.write('Temporary note\n')
source.rename(target)
target.write_bytes(b'# Temporary note\n')
assert not os.path.lexists(source), 'notes.txt must be absent'
assert target.read_bytes() == b'# Temporary note\n', 'Unexpected notes.md content'
print('Verified: notes.txt is absent; notes.md contains exactly # Temporary note followed by a newline.')
PY
